source.title: Sage-Taiyi: A Metacognitive Architecture for Scientific Discovery

object_level.target: Build an AI system that decides what to investigate next by continuously revising its own model of evidence, assumptions, and open questions.
object_level.idea_summary: Explicit dual-layer architecture: object-level search (Target Tree + Idea Graph) regulated by a meta-level that monitors and updates scientific understanding, then steers both targets and reusable reasoning methods.
key_evidence: Leads all eight metrics on Taiyi-Bench (265 tasks, 50 papers, 10 disciplines); overall 54.0 vs 47.9 for AI Scientist-v2
Raised cobalt-catalyzed carbonylation yield from trace to 84% and photocatalytic allylic amination from 13% to 69% in expert-guided wet-lab collaborations

active_assumptions: Metacognitive regulation (monitoring + control of one's own understanding) is a necessary component for effective long-horizon scientific search
Reusable methodological heuristics can be explicitly selected and applied
unresolved_questions: How well does the metacognitive loop scale when the experimental feedback loop is fully autonomous rather than expert-guided?
What is the minimal set of cognitive operators required for robust performance across domains?
meta_level.steering_signal: Implement a lightweight version of the monitoring-control loop inside the knowledge synthesizer so every ingested item produces an explicit steering recommendation rather than only a summary.

downstream_actions: Prototype the three meta fields (assumptions, unresolved questions, steering_signal) as required schema on every new research entry
Test the loop on the next 10 papers ingested for ChemLab or energy work

source.title: An AI-native experimental laboratory for autonomous biomolecular operations

object_level.target: Create a laboratory system that can plan and execute complex multi-instrument biomolecular workflows from a high-level goal with minimal human intervention.
object_level.idea_summary: Multi-agent architecture (Planner, Protocol, Reagent, Code, Hardware) co-designed with the physical instruments from the start; orchestrates >20 instrument types across >11,000 steps while humans only restock and maintain hardware.
key_evidence: Matched expert enzymatic DNA synthesis yields
Completed end-to-end DNA data storage with exact recovery and identified/validated a clinical KRAS G13D mutation

active_assumptions: Co-design of models, experiments, and instruments is superior to retrofitting agents onto human-centric lab layouts
Current multi-agent orchestration is sufficient for nucleic-acid workflows of moderate complexity
unresolved_questions: How does performance and reliability degrade when the chemical/biological space becomes less standardized?
What failure modes appear when the system must handle novel instruments or protocols not seen during development?
meta_level.steering_signal: If ChemLab moves toward closed-loop or simulated experimentation, adopt the multi-agent separation (especially explicit Protocol and Hardware agents with self-correction) rather than a single monolithic controller.

downstream_actions: Map AutoDNA agent roles onto any future ChemLab automation layer
Note the human boundary (restocking + maintenance only) as the current practical limit

source.title: Generalized Lawson-Cordey-Mills accessibility of fusion ignition

object_level.target: Determine the lowest-energy route to a self-heating (ignited) fusion plasma under realistic conditions.
object_level.idea_summary: Unified power-balance framework shows the most efficient path is heat the plasma first, then increase density. Trace tungsten and synchrotron radiation significantly raise the required pressure.
key_evidence: Heat-first, density-second path requires substantially less external energy than the reverse sequence common in many designs
Tungsten at 10⁻⁴ concentration approximately doubles ignition pressure requirement
Framework incorporates fuel dilution, helium ash, impurities, and synchrotron losses

active_assumptions: The modified Lawson criterion plus the four additional accessibility conditions adequately capture the dominant physics
Current materials choices (especially tungsten) will remain relevant for next-generation devices
unresolved_questions: How sensitive is the optimal path to improvements in confinement or the use of spin-polarized fuel?
What is the practical engineering cost of implementing lithium-coated walls or other mitigations at scale?
meta_level.steering_signal: For any energy-systems tracking or Kardashev-related work, treat the heat-first pathway and impurity sensitivity as updated baseline constraints rather than older ideal Lawson numbers.

downstream_actions: Update internal energy-system notes with the heat-first principle and tungsten warning
Flag lithium-wall and spin-polarized fuel concepts for later monitoring
